ExtraBar 1.3.4 – Search, Browse & Organize Your Menus! 🔍📂

✨ What's New

  • Search Inside App Menus: Start typing to instantly filter the actions in any app's menu — a new search toggle in the menu toolbar makes finding the right command quick, even in long menus!
  • Folders Show Their Contents: Folder items now reveal their live contents right inside the bar menu, so you can browse into files and subfolders without ever opening Finder!
  • Move & Copy Between App Menus: Reorganize freely by copying or moving actions (and dividers) from one app's menu into another, with a clearer, more reliable destination picker!
  • Multi-Select Menu Editing: Select multiple menu items at once to batch-delete, move, or copy them — the selection entry point is now clearer, with the Delete button right where you'd expect it!

🔧 Improvements

  • Adaptive Onboarding: The welcome screens now adapt their colors to look great in both Light and Dark mode!
  • Smarter Quick Add for Shiori: New bookmarks default to your currently active Shiori folder, so they always land in the right place!
  • Safer Preset Shortcuts: Preset hotkeys now require a modifier key, preventing accidental triggers from a single keypress!
  • Smoother Notch Hover: Hover behavior around the notch is now more stable and refined!

🐞 Bug Fixes

  • Launch Crash Fixed: Fixed a launch crash that could occur when license validation couldn't reach the server and fell back to local checks!
  • Collapsed Menu Click: Fixed the primary click not working on collapsed menus!
  • Folder Clicks & Shortcuts: Fixed folder clicks and keyboard shortcuts inside menus!
  • Live Menu Refresh: Live bar menus now refresh correctly after moving or copying items between apps!
  • Preserved Folder Configuration: Folder menu configuration and menu styling are now preserved correctly when editing!

What's Next?

We're always working on making ExtraBar more powerful and intuitive! More features and improvements are on the way based on your feedback!

Thank you for being part of the ExtraBar community! Your feedback drives every improvement we make.
